info.title: Specimen Repository REST API
info.description: Production-grade REST API backend for managing biological specimens, taxonomy, collections, researchers, locations, media files, specimen loans, and administrative audit logging. Built with Laravel 13 and MongoDB.

get.description: Retrieve paginated administrative audit logs tracking system actions.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by action (e.g. LOGIN, CREATE_SPECIMEN, APPROVE_LOAN)

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Filter by resource type (e.g. Specimen, Loan)

get.description: Retrieve details of a single audit log entry by ID.

post.description: Authenticate administrator with email and password to receive a Bearer API token.

get.description: Retrieve details of the currently authenticated administrator.
Retrieve paginated list of specimen collections.
Retrieve details of a single collection by ID.

put.description: Update details of an existing collection.

get.description: Retrieve all specimens categorized under a specific collection.
Retrieve paginated list of specimen loan transactions.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by loan status (pending, approved, active, returned, overdue, cancelled)

post.description: Create a new specimen loan transaction. Specimen must be in active status.

get.description: Retrieve details of a single loan transaction by ID.

post.description: Approve a pending loan transaction. Automatically changes the specimen status to loaned.

400.description: Invalid status transition or specimen unavailable

post.description: Record the return of a loaned specimen. Automatically changes the specimen status back to active.

notes.example: Returned in pristine condition without damages

message.example: Specimen returned and status restored to active.

post.description: Cancel a loan transaction. Reverts specimen status to active if previously approved.

reason.example: Borrower cancelled request due to grant timing

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of collection sites and repository storage locations.

post.description: Register a new collection site or repository location.

get.description: Retrieve details of a single location by ID.

put.description: Update details of an existing location.

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of research projects.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (planning, active, completed, suspended)

get.description: Retrieve details of a single research project by ID.

put.description: Update details of an existing research project.

get.description: Retrieve all biological specimens associated with this project.

200.description: Paginated list of specimens in project

get.description: High-level counts and status distributions powered by MongoDB aggregation pipelines.
Detailed breakdown of specimens by status, kingdom, preservation method, and monthly acquisition trends.
Taxonomic aggregation of specimens grouped by class, order, and top families.
Collection statistics including specimen counts per collection and status groupings.
Loan analytics including status breakdown, overdue loans list, and top borrowing researchers.
Retrieve paginated list of researchers and scientists.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by name, email, institution, specialization

post.description: Register a new researcher or external investigator.

get.description: Retrieve details of a single researcher by ID.

put.description: Update details of an existing researcher.

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of biological specimens with optional search, filtering, and sorting.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query across scientific name, common name, code, genus, species

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (active, loaned, damaged, lost, deaccessioned)

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Field to sort by (created_at, specimen_code, scientific_name, collection_date)

get.description: Retrieve complete record for a single specimen by ID.

put.description: Update details of an existing specimen.

delete.description: Remove a specimen record (super_admin or admin role required).

get.description: Retrieve all uploaded images for a specimen.

post.description: Upload and associate an image file with a specimen.

get.description: Retrieve all attached documents and field notes for a specimen.

post.description: Upload and associate a document (PDF, notes, sequencing) with a specimen.

description.example: Field collection log and GPS logs

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of taxonomic records with optional search.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by scientific name, common name, family, genus

get.description: Retrieve details of a single taxon by ID.

put.description: Update details of an existing taxon.

description.example: Apex avian predator endemic to the Philippines
